description: Integrate Dharmamitra ByT5 Sanskrit Grammar model for morphological analysis, verb root identification, and enhanced dictionary lookups. Display results in stacked sections in the dictionary panel.

userStories.title: Backend Dharmamitra service integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Dharmamitra service that provides morphological analysis for Sanskrit words.
acceptanceCriteria: Install dharmamitra-sanskrit-grammar package in requirements.txt
Create DharmamitraMorphologyService class in backend/app/services/dharmamitra_service.py
Service provides analyze_word() returning lemma, unsandhied form, morphological tags, and meanings
Service provides analyze_text() for full sentence/verse analysis
Graceful fallback when Dharmamitra unavailable (return None, log warning)
Service is initialized lazily on first use (avoid startup delay)

userStories.title: Backend morphology API endpoint
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need an API endpoint to get morphological analysis for a word.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/morphology/{word} returns morphological analysis
Response includes: lemma, unsandhied, tag (Case/Gender/Number), meanings list
Accepts word in Devanagari or IAST
Returns 200 with empty analysis if word not recognized
Response time under 1 second for single word
Endpoint documented in CLAUDE.md

userStories.title: Backend dhatu (verb root) identification
userStories.description: As a reader, I need to see the verb root (dhatu) when looking up a verb form.
acceptanceCriteria: Dharmamitra returns dhatu/root for verb forms
API response includes dhatu field when word is a verb
Link dhatu to dictionary entry for the root
Include verb class (gana) if available from analysis
Handle cases where dhatu cannot be determined (return null)
userStories.notes: Example: gacchati -> dhatu: gam (to go), gana: 1

userStories.title: Frontend morphology display component
userStories.description: As a reader, I want to see grammatical analysis when I click a word.
acceptanceCriteria: Create MorphologySection component showing grammatical tags
Display: Lemma (base form), Case, Gender, Number, Person (for verbs)
Use readable labels (e.g., 'Nominative' not 'Case=Nominative')
Loading state while fetching morphology
Graceful handling when no analysis available
userStories.notes: Display in stacked sections below sandhi split

userStories.title: Frontend dhatu display with dictionary link
userStories.description: As a reader, I want to see the verb root and click it for dictionary lookup.
acceptanceCriteria: Show dhatu section for verb forms
Display: Root (dhatu), Verb class (gana), Meaning
Dhatu is clickable - triggers dictionary lookup for root
Visual indicator showing it's a clickable link
Hide dhatu section for non-verb words

userStories.title: Frontend stacked panel layout
userStories.description: As a reader, I want all word analysis in organized stacked sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Dictionary panel shows sections in order: Sandhi Split, Morphology, Dhatu, Dictionary
Each section has clear heading with icon
Sections collapse/expand independently
Empty sections are hidden (not shown as 'No data')
Smooth transitions when sections appear/disappear
userStories.notes: Progressive disclosure - users can focus on what they need

userStories.title: Enhanced dictionary with grammar info
userStories.description: As a reader, I want dictionary entries to show grammatical information.
acceptanceCriteria: Dictionary entries show gender for nouns (m./f./n.)
Show word class (noun, verb, adjective, etc.) when available
Highlight the current inflected form vs. base form
Show both Dharmamitra meanings and dictionary definitions
De-duplicate meanings if they appear in both sources
userStories.notes: Combine Dharmamitra 60K meanings with MW/Apte definitions

userStories.title: Caching for morphology results
userStories.description: As a developer, I need caching to improve performance for repeated lookups.
acceptanceCriteria: Cache morphology results in memory (LRU cache)
Cache key: word + script normalized to SLP1
Cache size configurable (default: 1000 entries)
Cache expires after 1 hour (configurable)
Log cache hit/miss statistics
PWA caches morphology API responses for offline use
userStories.notes: Dharmamitra model inference is expensive - cache aggressively
